services.name: Changing Exhibits
services.desc: Our changing exhibit program brings fresh stories into the gallery throughout the year - drawn from our collections, our community partnerships, and the living history of Pennsylvania German culture. Whether you visited last month or last decade, there's something here you haven't seen before. Each exhibit listing on this page includes the subject matter, artifact types, and the date range it will be on view. If you're planning a visit around a specific exhibit, check the dates before you come so you don't miss it. services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Your event deserves a setting with a story. At Schwenkfelder Library & Heritage Center, you can host your wedding, corporate gathering, or private celebration on a working heritage campus in Pennsburg, Pennsylvania - surrounded by museum collections, period architecture, and a fully reconstructed 1826 Pennsylvania barn that guests remember long after the evening ends. Surround your guests in local history while enjoying all the amenities that our contemporary building has to offer. The Schwenkfelder Library & Heritage Center provides unique settings for receptions, conferences, meetings, and reunions. services.name: Culinary Journey
services.desc: Pennsylvania German food is well-loved by those who grew up in its culture-and many others who have been fortunate to taste it. From chicken pot pie to scrapple to apple dumplings, many love to eat it-or, in the case of scapple, love to hate it. It creates conversation and good times wherever it is served or discussed. As part of the Schwenkfelder Library & Heritage Center’s mission to preserve the history of Pennsylvania German settlement in the Upper Perkiomen Valley, we often have programs and exhibits that revolve around food. services.name: School Groups
services.desc: Schwenkfelder Library & Heritage Center offers school groups a hands-on Pennsylvania history field trip that connects directly to what students are already studying - immigration, agricultural life, religious freedom, folk art, and primary source literacy - inside one of the most distinctive heritage museums in southeastern PA. General admission is free for school groups, and our programming is designed to meet teachers where they are: aligned to Pennsylvania history and social studies standards, adaptable by grade level, and built around the kind of physical, artifact-centered learning that makes a classroom lesson stick. services.name: Dive trip
services.desc: Adult programs at Schwenkfelder Library & Heritage Center take you past the exhibit label and into the real story - covering Pennsylvania German history, Fraktur, folk traditions, agricultural heritage, and genealogy research through hands-on workshops, expert lectures, and seasonal presentations. Our adult programs are designed for engaged community members - lifelong learners, genealogy researchers, and anyone who finds themselves wanting to know more than a single exhibit can hold. No academic background required. No prior knowledge assumed. Just genuine interest in the history that shaped this region.
